description: Verify that TCP in TIME-WAIT sends an ACK with next expected SEQ after receiving any segment with OTW SEQ number (RFC 793 §3.9 p69)
approach:
[Objective]
In TIME-WAIT, OTW segments — even FINs from the peer's retransmission — must trigger an ACK announcing the proper SEQ. 2 phases test FIN and data shapes.

[Scenario — chronological]
Two phases (FIN, data) — DUT in TIME-WAIT after handshake → CLOSE-WAIT → LAST-ACK style FW2 prelude. Tester injects OTW segment of the phase shape.

[Pass condition]
DUT replies proper-SEQ ACK in both phases.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase: handshake / DUT FIN / tester FIN ACK / probe ACK missing.

verdicts.Pass: DUT acked OTW probe in TIME-WAIT (FIN and data) — normal
verdicts.Fail_p1_no_tester_fin_ack: No DUT ACK to tester FIN phase 1
verdicts.Fail_p1_no_probe_ack: No DUT ACK to OTW FIN in TIME-WAIT
verdicts.Fail_p2_no_tester_fin_ack: No DUT ACK to tester FIN phase 2
verdicts.Fail_p2_no_probe_ack: No DUT ACK to OTW data in TIME-WAIT
